claim_text: The 2021 consensus added choroidal abnormalities (bright patchy nodules on OCT/near-infrared reflectance imaging) as an NF1 diagnostic criterion, counted interchangeably with >=2 iris Lisch nodules rather than as a separate criterion.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Modified Delphi expert consensus (74/76 experts); rubric forbids expert_opinion at strength >=4, so capped at 2. Recommendation, not an empirical finding. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Choroidal abnormalities and Lisch nodules as interchangeable criteria. No specific HPO for NF1-associated choroidal abnormalities; HP:0009737 (Lisch nodules) used as the grounded criterion. | Re-grounded 2026-11-27 for issue #88: ASSOCIATED_WITH replaced with v2.0 Biolink predicate. ASSOCIATED_WITH -> HAS_PHENOTYPE (Disease -> Phenotype).
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
